purpose: Calibration and validation without holdout leakage, with practical identifiability treated as a first-class scientific gate.

role_rules.calibration: estimate parameters and diagnose rank/conditioning using only calibration observations
role_rules.structural_selection: compare admitted/candidate structures and baselines with expanding/rolling time-respecting origins; may inform promotion/degradation
role_rules.evaluation_holdout: inspect once only after model structure and selection judgement are fixed; cannot be reused as independent holdout for a model revised after inspection

baseline_policy.reason: A behavioural mechanism must demonstrate value beyond simple time-series persistence or a stable spread before it is promoted.

central_model_rule: Only mechanisms that pass data sufficiency, practical-identifiability, structural-selection and evaluation gates may enter a validated reference model. Failure at an earlier gate cannot be rescued by inspecting or fitting the final holdout.
alpha_0_6_gate: Interactive Web Simulator may expose calibrated behavioural dynamics only if Alpha 0.5 produces at least one scientifically defensible validated reference mechanism; otherwise 0.6 requires a scope decision rather than automatic progression.
